issue.title: Artifacts split spacer grows from 8 to 33 cells at 140 columns
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/launch_context_bar.py::ArtifactsHeader.fit_launch_context_bar`

Open the TUI at 140 columns, switch to Artifacts, and let the launch-context row settle. Inspect `#artifacts-split-spacer`: it expands from the 8-cell base to 33 cells when the header-width threshold is met. The spacer is intended to mirror the 8-cell split badge; this extra width shifts the centered sub-tab strip at wide sizes. The sizing branch computes `mirror = badge_width + bar.content_cells` and assigns it whenever `header_width >= needed`.

The regression should cover the 140-column boundary and verify the spacer stays consistent with the split badge so the tab strip remains centered.

task_type_fields.impact: The Artifacts sub-tab strip is miscentered on wide terminals.
task_type_fields.repro: At 140 columns, open the TUI, switch to Artifacts, wait for the launch-context row to settle, and inspect #artifacts-split-spacer: it grows from 8 to 33 cells.

issue.creation_reason: I found this while reviewing the approved Artifacts sub-tab refresh. The source shows the 8-cell base is replaced by the full badge-plus-launch-context width on wide headers, miscentering the strip.
